proposed.sourceName: Islam Q&A — Fatwa 258312 'Ruling on bones from non-halal meat and vessels made from them'
proposed.paraphrase: This fatwa records the majority position (Maliki, Shafi'i, Hanbali) that bones from animals not islamically slaughtered are impure — consumption of the impure being impermissible — while noting the Hanafi/Ibn Taymiyyah view that bone is pure, and advises avoidance 'to be on the safe side regarding his religious commitment'. Under the strictest zabiha position, edible bone phosphate of unverified origin (worst case: porcine or non-slaughtered bones) is treated as haram.
